legend: HMGA2 (12q14.3) rearrangement in deep (aggressive) angiomyxoma. A Chromosome 12 schematic illustrates the HMGA2 locus and flanking dual-colour FISH probe set (upper left). Break-apart HMGA2 FISH demonstrates the presence of a rearrangement of this locus in tumour interphase nuclei (split red and green signals) (upper right). A schematic representation shows an HMGA2::YAP1 fusion identified in a deep (aggressive) angiomyxoma of the vulva with the junction between exon 3 of HMGA2 and exon 2 of YAP1 (retaining YAP1 functional tryptophan-tryptophan , glutamine-rich, and transcriptional activation domains), and an HMGA2::C12orf42 fusion identified in a deep (aggressive) angiomyxoma of the perineum with the fusion between exon 4 of HMGA2 and the last, non-coding exon 7 of C12orf42 (bottom).
A uniformly paucicellular neoplasm typically containing a prominent vascular component ranging from capillary to medium/large-sized vessels.
Deep (aggressive) angiomyxoma is composed of bland appearing spindle cells set within an abundant myxoedematous stroma containing delicate collagen fibrils.
